NEW GAME: https://www.roblox.com/games/8267733039/SPECTER
Specter: Legacy no longer receives updates besides essential maintenance. All our development efforts are going into the sequel, SPECTER. We appreciate your support over the years!

👻 Face your fears, and team up with up to 3 other players to discover evidence, explore the paranormal, and correctly guess the ghost. Earn money to get new items to help you find evidence.

🐛 Please report any bugs to us using our socials. If you enjoy the game, leave a like to show us your support! If we shut down, it's to push an update, sorry for the inconvenience!

⭐ Join the group for bonus rewards every match and a one-time cash boost!

WARNING: FLASHING LIGHTS & LOUD NOISES

USERS WITH ROBLOX PREMIUM GET 10% OFF PURCHASES USING IN-GAME CASH!

Inspired by the horror game Phasmophobia
